roster_grade.headline: In-season contender — elite QB/WR/TE spine, but a deep-yet-shaky RB room is the soft spot
roster_grade.window_explanation: Bo Nix and Mahomes anchor a superflex-elite QB room, DeVonta Smith/Tee Higgins headline a deep WR corps, and Colston Loveland is a top-3 dynasty TE at 22. The window is open now and for 3-4 years — the one risk is the RB room aging out.

strengths.label: Superflex QB spine
strengths.detail: Bo Nix (5,306) has passed Mahomes (5,109) as your top QB by value — two locked starters in a 2-QB league, with Shough (3,465) as a genuine trade chip.

strengths.label: Elite + deep WR
strengths.detail: Smith (3,699), Higgins (3,464), Parker Washington (2,953), Watson (2,615) start, with young Stribling/Bech/Cyrus Allen/Zavion Thomas behind — a clear surplus to deal from.

strengths.label: Loveland at TE
strengths.detail: 22 years old, top-3 dynasty TE (5,371). A weekly positional edge locked in for a decade.

strengths.label: Pick capital
strengths.detail: Holds a 2028 1st from Bijan Mustard (fka Macho King — bottom-tier team, likely an early pick) plus a 2027 2nd from Pitts-and-Swallows.

weaknesses.label: RB quality behind the volume
weaknesses.detail: 10 RBs but only ~3 startable: Javonte (26, Declining), Henry (32, Declining), Hubbard (27, Declining) all fading; the rest are darts (Demercado, Brooks) or unproven rookies (Claiborne, Randall).

weaknesses.label: No proven young RB
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey (25) is the youngest with a real role; there's no ascending back you can bank on. This is where your QB/WR surplus should be converted.

weaknesses.label: Thin behind Loveland at TE
weaknesses.detail: Hockenson (1,353) and Helm (1,248) are fine depth but there's a steep drop after your TE1.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Convert surplus into a young RB. You carry 3 QBs (Shough is expendable) and 10 WRs — Bijan Mustard is weak at QB and holds Breece Hall + Rome Odunze, making Shough your key to landing a real RB. Also sell Derrick Henry (32) to a win-now team while he's still producing.

QB.commentary: Bo Nix + Mahomes is the league's best SF pair. Shough is the sellable 3rd.

RB.commentary: Deep in bodies, thin in quality and youth. Henry/Javonte/Hubbard all declining; Harvey + rookies are the future. The position to upgrade.

WR.commentary: Smith/Higgins/Washington/Watson start; a stack of young WRs behind. Clear surplus.

TE.commentary: Loveland is elite; steep drop to Hockenson/Helm, but one starter is all you need.

trade_priority_order: Turn Shough (QB3) into a young RB — Bijan Mustard (weak QB) is the natural partner for Breece Hall
Sell Derrick Henry (32, Declining) to a win-now team while he still produces
Move a declining RB (Javonte/Hubbard) to an RB-needy rebuilder for youth
Flip Hockenson to a TE-needy team (Phil's Dong Dusters, You Hate Us) for a younger asset
Package spare WR depth (P.Washington/Watson/Boutte) as sweeteners, not standalone sells

sell_now.ask: A young RB (Breece Hall) or a Rising WR

sell_now.reason: 32 and Declining — still producing, which is exactly when you sell. Win-now buyers (Rolling Ball, Pitts, Threat Level) value him most.
sell_now.ask: A younger WR (A.J. Brown) or a pick + piece

sell_now.ask: A young WR (Jordyn Tyson) or a pick

Elite young RB (6,446), the dream target. They're selling and weak at QB+RB — aspirational, but Shough + a WR + a pick is the conversation.

do_not_trade: Patrick Mahomes — SF ceiling; move only for a historic overpay
Bo Nix — now your QB1 by value, in his prime
Colston Loveland — top-3 dynasty TE at 22, untouchable
DeVonta Smith — prime WR1 (only in a Jeremiyah Love-tier swing)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: Hold the 2028 1st from Bijan Mustard (likely early) and your own future 1sts; use your 2027 2nd and 2nd-4th rounders as sweeteners in a young-RB deal.

pick_strategy.portfolio_summary: Draft complete (ran linear, slot 9): 1.09 Kenyon Sadiq (TE), 2.09 De'Zhaun Stribling (WR), 3.09 Demond Claiborne (RB), 4.09 Adam Randall (RB). Sadiq was later flipped to Bijan Mustard (fka Macho King) for a 2028 1st.
pick_strategy.draft_day_strategy: Good value draft — best-available at each slot, with two rookie RBs (Claiborne, Randall) added to refresh the backfield. The Sadiq-for-2028-1st flip turned a blocked TE4 into a likely-early future first.

top_pick_at_109.name: Kenyon Sadiq (drafted, since traded)
top_pick_at_109.reason: Best-available at 9; redundant behind Loveland, so correctly flipped to Bijan Mustard for a 2028 1st.

picks_ok_to_package: 2027 2nd (from Pitts-and-Swallows) and 2nd-4th rounders for a proven young RB

outlook.projected_power_rank: Mid-pack by roster value, but plays up due to superflex QB strength — a real contender.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Contention window open now through ~2028 on the back of the QB/WR/TE spine. Sustaining it depends on converting surplus into younger RB help and the rookie RBs developing.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters open the season as a legitimate contender. Bo Nix + Mahomes is superflex-elite, the WR room runs deep, and Loveland is a top-3 dynasty TE. The soft spot is a bloated-but-aging RB room — rookies Claiborne and Randall plus the banked 2028 1st are the long-term answer. Win now while the core is in its prime, and spend the QB/WR surplus on a real RB as the weeks reveal needs.
key_risks: Henry (32) and Javonte both fall off a cliff the same season
Bo Nix regresses toward a game-manager, softening your SF edge
Sitting on the QB/WR surplus too long while its value decays
key_upside_factors: A rookie RB (Claiborne or Randall) carves out a role and stabilizes the backfield
Shough earns a starting job and his trade value spikes
One of the young WRs (Stribling, Bech, Cyrus Allen) breaks out

teams_to_watch.why: Weak at QB, holds Breece Hall + Rome Odunze, and is selling — your #1 trade partner for a young RB.
Rebuilding and selling, weak at QB and RB — holds Jeremiyah Love. Aspirational RB target if you overpay with Shough + a WR.
The value leader and win-now — the best home for Derrick Henry.
